name: Matsuno (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Matsuno town emblem in yellow: a broken ring enclosing a downward triangle with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Matsuno, a town in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 December 1965.

features.role: Matsuno town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a downward triangle with a disc
